news.analysis: Cousins spent six years in Minnesota, where he threw for 23,265 yards and 171 touchdowns in 88 games with a passer rating of 101.2. He will reunite with an offense he knows, which increases the fantasy value for Minnesota pass catchers, particularly Justin Jefferson. Cousins remains fantasy relevant as a high-end QB2 with some low-end QB1 potential.

news.analysis: It's a tough blow for the Cardinals, who just elevated Minshew to the starting role after making a miracle comeback against the Cowboys. With Minshew out at least in the short term, if not the whole season, Carson Beck will now take the reigns as the Arizona QB1. He won't have many options to throw to aside from Trey McBride, as the team also lost Michael Wilson today as well.
